children: LVMH would do well to make some of its luxury products more affordable, analysts at Bernstein write in a note. The French luxury-goods giant booked a slowdown in sales growth for the third quarter, led by a fall in sales at the core fashion division. The group should act on its price-mix in order to make its core products more affordable to the "broader consumer audience" targeted by brands like Louis Vuitton, Bernstein says. (joshua.kirby@wsj.com; @joshualeokirby)
